name: mcl-analytics-root
description: Root package manager for MCL Analytics platform

scripts.dev:backend: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync('Backend/.linuxenv/bin/python') ? '.linuxenv/bin/python' : fs.existsSync('Backend/.venv/bin/python') ? '.venv/bin/python' : fs.existsSync('Backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') ? '.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : 'python3'; spawn(py, ['-m', 'uvicorn', 'main:app', '--reload', '--port', '8000'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: 'Backend' });"
scripts.dev:full: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "yellow,blue" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
